claim: A Layer 2 palette priority bit can put chosen Layer 2 pixels above sprites, so a sprite passes behind a bush.

evidence.text: In the sprites build a goblin passes behind a bush (Layer 2 priority), seen in MAME; the host's look was still to come.
evidence.quote: sprites, a goblin passes behind a bush (Layer 2 priority). Host's look still to come.

evidence.text: N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite V06): the priority colour drew over the sprites in order SLU and in blend mode 110, and not where it was the transparent colour (operator).

limit: Seen in MAME, and by eye on the N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone, core 3.03.00, nxsuite V06).
